AwakeningQuest_KinOfSheredyn_01_Step02_E:
Cerberus, the artificial entity, keeps its side of the bargain, furnishing the Kin with many trinkets that enhance their power. With the supplied resources it assembles the sub-space equipment it hopes will lead it to recontact with its masters, the Endless.
After several days, Shaparenko returns to the site to meet with it again. Entering the inner chamber, he finds detritus littering the ground: smashed crystals, broken equipment, electronic odds and ends. As they speak, glitching pulses of light tear through the being’s artificial form, and a terrible static noise assails Shaparenko’s ears.
Cerberus is crestfallen.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter01_S: I am Bogdan Shaparenko. The highest authority of the Kin of Sheredyn on Saiadha. I’m seeking one of our former soldiers named Rzeld.

Many decades have passed since the Kin of Sheredyn, conquerors from the stars, set their sights on Saiadha. A dangerous, yet fascinating world they could finally call home, chosen by their revered founder, Commander Garin.
Garin, decorated defender of the United Empire, personal emissary of Emperor Zelevas himself. Garin who drove the Necrophage horrors back to the depths, Garin the builder, Garin the righteous… yet in the end, Garin the lost. It was one tragic day, twenty winters ago, when she disappeared into the mists, never to return.
The mantle of leadership then fell on a young officer who knew nothing about the games of Garin’s inner-circle, but had proved himself in battle—General Bogdan Shaparenko.
Despite all his achievements, though, the cult of Garin’s command never vanished. And it has even grown stronger since the starfall—a hammer blow dropped from the sky on the world of Saiadha. Terrifying storms, quakes and great waves followed, reducing to rubble everything the Kin had fought so hard to build for almost half-a-century.
It is now General Shaparenko’s duty to rebuild.
And, perhaps, finally step out of his predecessor’s shadow?

General Shaparenko’s reconstruction efforts are bearing fruit; although their situation is far from perfect, the Kin can look to the future for the first time since the chaos that followed the starfall.
Yet, despite successfully handling this crisis, General Shaparenko continues to be compared to his missing predecessor—the Kin’s revered founder, Commander Garin.
Garin, decorated defender of the United Empire, personal emissary of Emperor Zelevas himself. Garin who drove the Necrophage horrors back to the depths, Garin the builder, Garin the righteous… But also Garin who refused Shaparenko’s entry to her inner circle, deeming him too young, forcing him to prove himself in combat instead.
Many Kin hold it against him, praying that the legendary Garin, lost for decades, will return from the wilds to relight their path...
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter04_S:
Brezvez’s kidnapping and imprisonment of Przemko is a heavy burden on Shaparenko’s shoulders. Brezvez has always been an exemplary officer, with a long, distinguished career spanning the entire period the Kin have been on Saiadha, right back to being a key figure under Garin’s leadership. And when Shaparenko assumed command, he was among his most vocal supporters, one of the few to never compare him to his illustrious predecessor.
And yet, the twilight of his military duty, this hideous act sullies his name.
But why? Why did Brezvez go to such lengths? What is he hiding?  What does he know about Garin?
The General will not speak of his crimes to the rank-and-file—morale must be kept high—but Brezvez must be caught. The Kin’s fate depends on it.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter05_S:
With Shaparenko's most trusted Chosen stronger than ever, concerns over rebellion recede. Without names though, he cannot relax.
A grim tension lies on everyone’s shoulders.

With Shaparenko's settlements stronger than ever, concerns over rebellion recede. Without names though, he cannot relax.
A grim tension lies on everyone’s shoulders.

With more Chosen than ever stalking the empire, concerns over rebellion recede. Without names though, he cannot relax.
A grim tension lies on everyone’s shoulders.

Lieutenant General Brezvez is no longer a threat. Held in a secret facility known to few Kin, his confession has shocked General Shaparenko to the core.
He would’ve doubted his words if it wasn’t for the journals that he handed over upon his capture. Commander Garin’s journals, no less. Their authenticity is undisputed. Garin was going to recommend to the United Empire back on Raia that Saiadha be readied for full Dust extraction operations, even with all the risks that entailed. She’d had a taste of the world’s powers and wanted more.
No wonder the then-leadership had mutinied, killed her, and created this lost messiah myth. Still, Shaparenko is unsure of what to do with Brezvez. His sense of loyalty is impressive, if twisted, and he learned much about Saiadha while studying Garin. And the names of his fellow conspirators have not been divulged…
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter06A_:
The Kin have successfully secured the starfarers’ ship.
Now begins the long, arduous task of rebuilding their starfaring capabilities. It won’t be easy. Seawater has breached much of the vessel, destroying systems and corroding metal. Great fronds of kelp lay entangled throughout, while barnacles cling wherever they can. More than that, the technology inside is strange, unfamiliar to even the eldest and wisest of the Kin.
Shaparenko isn’t worried, though. Something stirs in his heart. Something he shares with all Kin. Long ago they came from the stars.
In time, they will return.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter06B_:
Brezvez walks free, while the truth about Garin is kept to a small inner circle.
While the Kin await a return that can never come, attention must turn to what sort of society General Shaparenko should shape.
He is no longer merely a steward awaiting the return of the true power—he is the power.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter01_Ste:
Twenty winters have passed since the mantle of leadership fell on General Shaparenko, yet he could remember no harder time.
The devastation of the storms have scarred many Kin and the ensuing starfalls have stirred ancient memories of their own times traveling the heavens.
Sermons are more evangelic, congregations greater, and canticles sung with unrecalled zeal.
Garin’s legend burns brighter than ever, with many Kin desperate for their lost leader to return from the wilds and relight their path. For the leader of the Kin, it is a testing time.

Faction_KinOfSheredyn_LeaderIntro: [TBD] A fierce, strong leader, Shaparenko found himself thrust into power at a relatively young age after the acting Kin commander was killed by a Necrophage surge twenty winters past. Never hiding from the field, Shaparenko has kept morale among the Kin as high as can be expected given the harsh conditions, the deteriorating technology, the deadly seas, and, most of all, the Kin's growing sense of rootlessness. The starfalls have unsettled him, yet he is determined to take advantage of any opportunities they might bring—even if that means destroying the Kin's most closely cherished beliefs.
RogueQuest_UnitedEmpire_Chapter01_Step01: The Order of Zelevas was born in blood and screams, wrestled away from the Kin of Sheredyn in an ugly, drawn-out struggle. Long had discontent been whispered in General Shaparenko’s camps and lands. His ambition was too limited, his mindset too defensive. Yet it wasn’t until Zlatan Vecc, veteran of many bitter tours across the island, channeled that displeasure into purpose, and a splinter movement began to emerge. Emperor Zelevas’ name would no longer be taken in vain. After months of secretive gatherings, scouting trips, stockpiling of weapons, a small but determined corps under Imperator Vecc’s command marched out of Garin’s Rest in the dead of night, setting the granary ablaze as a distraction. Despite the fire occupying many of Shaparenko’s soldiers, bloody fighting ensued, Vecc’s army fighting a rearguard action against men and women they’d broken bread with earlier that very day. Every death that night was a needless tragedy. Wounded yet victorious, the Order of Zelevas trekked on, leaving one Kin survivor to deliver a message to Shaparenko. Come after us again at your peril.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter02_S: Przemko, a Kin youth, is missing.
We have a situation, General. One of our most promising recruits, Przemko, is missing. Slipped past the patrols... Likely searching the nearby ruins for evidence of this site connected to Garin.
A site alleged to connect to Garin, you mean. Przemko may be promising, but this time he has abandoned his post. Whatever his potential, I cannot allow this!
Quickly, all Kin to arms! Gather whoever you can and see them off. As for you, Przemko, look at the consequences of your priceless "truth"...

Przemko is healing back in the capital, though his actions have divided the Kin. Some resent both his obsession with Garin and his willingness to desert his post in order to pursue it. Others, supporters of the Great Search, however, approve of his path, and may even attempt to follow in his footsteps. Tensions simmer. Regardless, daily life continues, the noise of industry and commerce rising from {0}’s main thoroughfare. Banners flutter in the breeze, mouthwatering smells drift from the cooking pits, and steel clashes with steel.
...while others cannot hide their joy. We are becoming divided. Those who are angry... they are not angry with you, but with Przemko. We’ll hide him while he recovers.
It's more than his disobedience deserves, but very well. I will turn our renewed strength into unity.
Ah, I've just had word, General. Przemko's already asking for permission to resume searching that site supposedly linked to Garin!
Of course he is... But I'll allow it. Given how much his accident divided the Kin, it'll be a relief to know that he's away for a while.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter03_S: The soldiers are getting ready. Send Przemko to scout its surroundings while we prepare!
The soldiers are getting ready. Send Przemko to scout its surroundings while we prepare!

The seas have fallen. Great tracts of land lie exposed for the first time in thousands of years. Where once only terrible creatures swam, now only rotting kelp lies, and the Kin can pass without fear.
Young Przemko sets out to explore these new glistening climes, promising to be careful where he ventures... until he finally finds it. That controversial site, the one that might hold answers to Commander Garin’s fate!
Reluctantly, and despite some strong misgivings from some quarters, General Shaparenko makes plans for Kin forces to visit it. However, before the expedition can be assembled, the growing tensions at the heart of the society must be addressed...

Relying on Przemko’s scouting reports sent from the field, Kin forces successfully navigate through the many hazards of the once submerged site. Old scraps found in the ruins prove to be a boon.
However, there is no sign of Garin’s remains, though there is clear evidence that she once took shelter in these dark depths. How she ventured beneath the waves is a nagging question.
In one chamber, sparkling with motes of Dust, crude living arrangements are found, together with some of her possessions. Why did she come here?
To study? Steal? Commune?
Disturbingly, the chamber also shows clear signs of a struggle—a recent one. An old Kin insignia was found among the mess...

Sadly, I think so. Even though that insignia is too old to be his, we’ve had no contact since his last scouting report. Also, we found a trail, General. Kin boots. Heavy, like they were carrying something—

More savage fighting follows, but the Kin forces prevail. After defeating the sellswords, they discover young Przemko bound up nearby.
He is bruised, yet unbroken.
I fear so. We found the beginnings of his name scratched onto the cell walls.
At least he’s still fighting. Brave, that one. What else?
Questioning the enemy survivors, we learned he’d been taken by some of their comrades-in-arms. They shouldn’t be far.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter04De: Brezvez must be brought to justice. And maybe kidnapping Przemko is the least of his crimes...
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter05_S: We agree, General. Przemko wanted this ending; it will strengthen him. I fear others may feel differently.
I will rally others to that conviction. Prepare the Wrath of the Skies. Brezvez’s reckoning will come from the stars he tried to sever us from.
And for those who know the truth, like Przemko?

FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter01_Ste: Deep in the ancient ruins the search party finds Przemko. Badly injured. And trespassing far from home. Shaparenko decides to let him rest. They will speak in the morning.
Przemko, a Kin youth, is missing.
Przemko is missing. Slipped past the patrols...
Another one determined to retrace the great Commander Garin’s footsteps, no doubt. One of our most promising youths, but he’s too impetuous.
You’re lucky we found you, Przemko. In winters past, the Necrophage have swarmed out of the depths of these ruins. You pay a lot for this obsession with Garin, don’t you?
You have the best interests of the Kin at heart. That is commendable. We all want to learn the truth, Przemko, but your methods are disrespectful, not to mention dangerous.
They are angry. Not with you. With Przemko. Word travels fast. They know of his defilement.
I will curb that excess of zeal. We’ll need to keep him out of the way, while he recovers.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter02Desc: Przemko thinks he saw the missing leader, Garin. Should the Great Search be reestablished?
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter02_Ste:
News of Przemko’s expedition to the {0} has spread like wildfire. Rumors that he sighted the messianic figure of Garin have only inflamed many Kins’ anger.
Among the most faithful, spurred on by the church, there are calls for the resurrection of the Great Search—expeditions that sought to find their missing Commander all those years ago.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter03Desc: Przemko is missing again. Could he have headed for the once-submerged site that Garin visited?

Hero_KinOfSheredyn_Defender_0Biography: Much to his never-ending shame, Csaba fled the battlefield on his first day of duty. Tasked with assaulting a dangerous nest, the legionary panicked and ran when he spied Necrophage drones closing. The punishment for desertion would've been severe, but what really kept Csaba from returning was the stigma and guilt. Instead, he lived in the wild, mastering his sword, and mastering his fears.
Hero_KinOfSheredyn_Defender_1Biography: A second-generation Kin, Radovan learnt that rather than coming from a proud line of Sheredyn, he was of Pilgrim ancestry, his parents covertly joining the mission to Saidaha in order to escape the United Empire homeworld. Any chances of leaving the planet to pursue their Pilgrim roots evaporated when they found themselves near-enough marooned on Saiadha, but Radovan’s parents hope that one day the time will come when their son can carry on their dream.
Hero_KinOfSheredyn_Defender_2Biography: A young, headstrong youth, Przemko is obsessed with the old Kin leader, Commander Garin, who disappeared in mysterious circumstances when Przemko was no taller than the grasses that surrounded his settlement. Listening to campfire stories of Garin's adventures and expeditions, Przemko grew up certain that the Kin's fortunes could be changed if only their savior returned from the wilderness.

TutorialScenario_Quest_KinOfSheredyn_Cha: We’ll learn to master Saiadha, Hadrada. We will preserve the Great Mother’s great work: order and learning. First, shelter and supplies.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter01_S: Terrible forces stir in our lands. I will face them, whatever Garin’s followers say!
They would delay reconstruction to seek Garin again. We will hear their case, Hadrada, but we cannot let waiting for her return destroy the home we must rebuild.
The settlements must wait. We will learn Garin’s fate and put this burden behind us. Hadrada, let’s review our leads.
I fear the delay, General. Refugees report traces of the old hermit, Rzeld.
Then take heart, Hadrada. Root him out and bring me his account.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter01_Ste: Seneschal, give me your report. There is much to rebuild, and I will waste no time.
I hear you, old friend. Tell me what troubles you.
Whoever is missing, I will bring them back. Send a search party; duty admits no favourites.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter01_S: Remember your oath. I am giving you the opportunity to serve again. Make yourself worthy of it.
This pleases the Mother. Take it! I will have this studied—it seems to point to an ancient site beneath the waters. Finding a route will take time, but I will see it done.
You came from the stars. Explain.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter01_Ste: The enemy’s slain, but they still give me the shivers, General. This world is a deathtrap.
The Necros are deadly, Hadrada. We’ll strengthen our defenses and stand together. We will make this world our home.
I will fortify against every threat.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter02_Ste: Strange forces stir in our lands. I will meet them; waiting for Garin will save no one!
I honour Garin’s achievements, Hadrada. We carry that duty now. We’ll prove ourselves by what we build.
I will hear the case for finding her, Hadrada. But I will not sacrifice our fragile settlements to endless waiting. My people need a home, and I intend to build it.
Her name gives hope. We must give them homes.
The settlements must wait. We will learn Garin’s fate and put this burden behind us. Hadrada, let’s review our leads.

[TBD] Hadrada, secure the area. I want answers.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter02_S: You were right to bring this to me, not to the lesser sons, Hadrada. Dark times, yes. I will raise our finest as examples of strength and calm. The rest will follow.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter03_S: The seas have fallen, as the reports foretold. I will mount the expedition now. The road is open; my people will advance.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter03_Ste: I will strengthen their faith, Hadrada, and secure their aid.
Give me your assessment.
Then I will test her information.
I have brought you out of this bind. You are reckless, but I do not abandon my soldiers. Now you will recover and answer my questions.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter04_Ste: I will take Brezvez alive and uncover his game. Further...
I see. Then I expect results.
I accept your offer. Now, tell me where my absent Lieutenant is. I will bring him in and make him answer for his actions.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter05_S: Your word is insufficient, Brezvez. I will strengthen the Chosen, my Favoured Sons, to crush any attempt by your "friends" to reassemble your cabal.
Nothing useful. He claims his accomplices have no cause to attack you as they did Garin. I fear we cannot know what we face. We must prepare.
Whatever rises against us, I will meet it behind strong defenses. Fortify the settlement.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter05_Ste: Hardly. I will crush the threat stirring in Saiadha’s depths. Tell me its strengths; I will determine how to counter them.
Nothing useful. He claims not to know the threat’s nature. I fear we cannot judge its strength.
I will prepare, whatever his intent.
Your warning is sound. I am responsible for their safety. Fortify our settlement; have disciplined soldiers ready at the walls.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter05_S: Now I will judge Brezvez and settle his fate.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn_Chapter05_Ste: I will decide Brezvez’s fate now.
FactionQuest_KinOfSheredyn02_Chapter06A_: Garin is gone. I will lead us onward.
Saiadha is dangerous, and beautiful. I will choose our future with open eyes: build a true home here, or restore the knowledge that will carry us back to Raia.

This pleases the Mother. It won’t happen in our lifetimes, but one day Kin will walk on Raia again. That is my command, and that is what we will strive for, every day forth. We must become a spacefaring people once again.

In a short hundred years, through our work, my people will begin the long journey home.
I fear the long wait. We must prepare our children to endure it, with real hope rather than Garin’s false promise.
The danger is real, Hadrada. I will give her children strong homes and learning, as Garin once did.
The Kin will follow you, General. Yet the Great Mother warned: men’s savagery must be balanced with women’s wisdom. Remember her voice as you build their future.
Thank you, Hadrada. I will heed her voice and the women who counsel me. I will leave her children a home worth inheriting, and leaders ready to guard it. To the Kin! To Saiadha!
Your caution is wise. I will guard her children against that corruption. We’ll build strong walls and keep discipline within them.
Knowing they must save themselves is liberating. This is a watershed day for the Kin.
The Great Mother, then Garin, now me: the first man in their line. I have earned that duty; I will heed their wisdom. To Saiadha! To our true home!

DiplomaticDialogues_Leader_KinOfSheredyn: Threaten her children again and you will have none of my mercy.
You stand firm. Hmph. Well done.
Good times. They never last. Drink.
I will not fail her work by rushing. I must think.
You wear my patience thin. Speak.
No time for fools. What do you want?
Cross me and pay. What is it?
You earned my respect. What do you need?
I am General Shaparenko, leader of the Kin of Sheredyn. Saiadha is changing. I have waited long for this. Get in my way and pay for it.
You are my equal. Sit. Welcome.
Come in. Hadrada. Bring the good drink.
You are here. Down to work.
Enough talk. What do you want?
Well? What is on your mind?
Why are you in my way?
Out with it. Waste no time.
Come in. The Great Mother's work will not finish itself. We talk.
Come. Eat with us. Her children do not go hungry at my table.
What do you need? I can help.
Saiadha's seas keep falling. That trouble you too?
Ever seen a tide go out and stay out? I have now.
Come in. Riches on that seabed. Her work needs them.
So. Why come to me now?
Here to lecture us? Or put us under heel?
You lead well. I respect that.
Wild dogs keep better order than you do.
The Great Mother did not build for you to tear down. It is war.
I will not let you treat her children like that!
